title: Exact bounded clause-deletion SAT over a renamable Horn base
claims: ExactRenamableHornDeletionSAT checks P membership for the exact ordinary CNF language at any fixed clause-deletion distance from renamable Horn.
BoundedClauseDeletionSAT checks the general class of fixed-depth deletion witnesses for a measured base family.
ExactPackedRenamableHornProductSAT checks exact satisfiability of a supplied renamable Horn base with a product-budgeted extra formula.
MeasuredClauseExtraction checks exact removal of an indexed clause and an out-of-range no-op.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
